events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, featuring legendary performances from artists like Jimi Hendrix and Janis Joplin.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of counter-culture. Woodstock: three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's your favourite legendary performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, the music world lost an icon. Elvis Presley's legacy as the King of Rock & Roll lives on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Remembering the influential rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996 in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Tupac Shakur, a voice that shaped a generation. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite Tupac lyric?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: The world lost a true guitar hero on this day in 1970. Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound continues to inspire. Which of his tracks is your go-to?

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, on this day in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. That cover, those songs – pure genius. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the trailblazing frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still 'Brass in Pocket' after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the inimitable Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. An album that continues to inspire hope and unity worldwide. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. Remember painstakingly syncing your entire CD collection? What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who is your definitive 007? And which Bond theme tune gets your heart racing?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering music legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite Lennon solo track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. So much music, so many different sounds. Which track from this double LP is your hidden gem?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incredible Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
